questions.question: What was Kanał Sportowy's revenue in 2025 according to the results?
answers: Nine and nine tenths of a million zlotys
questions.explanation: Tomek reads: nine and nine tenths of a million in revenue and three hundred thousand in losses.

questions.question: How did they divide the shares in Masuria?
questions.explanation: On the napkin they wrote: "KS – shares: 4 x 25%".

questions.question: What was the result of the vote on further development of the channel?
questions.explanation: They voted and it came out two to two — a tie without a decision-making majority.

questions.question: What does Sebastian Felkner say about partners?
answers: That everyone should have equal shares
That he takes employees with partner-like conditions but no voting rights in decisions
questions.explanation: Sebastian says he gives employees partner-like conditions, but without a vote in decisions.

questions.question: What does Krzysiek reply to Tomek at the end of the correspondence?
answers: That he wants to return to Kanał Sportowy
That next time there will be no partners
That they will sell the channel
questions.explanation: Krzysiek replies: "Next time – there will be no partners."
